title: 第一卷 第2章 她是我媳妇！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

第2章她是我的女人！

“真是蠢货一个啊！”

“……”

面对村民们的议论。

秦云却没有任何在意，而是径直走到女子面前，伸出了手！

“就你吧！”

闻言，女子身体颤抖了几下，眼神中的不甘也变成了绝望！

“愣着干什么，还不赶紧跟着走！”

见秦云选好了菜人，胖子金兵顿时不耐烦的说道！

那女子咬了咬牙，挣扎着想起身！

却发现双腿无力，怎么站都站不起来！

见此一幕！

秦云想了想，所幸直接把女子抱了起来，往村尾的家里走去！

青石沟本就不大，拢共不过三十来户人家。

村尾更是偏僻，几间破败的土坯房散落在山脚，远远望去像是坟包。

所以一直被人认为风水不好！

原本村尾的几户早就搬走了！

唯一的住户就是秦云家。

“到了！”

秦云抱着女人在一处院子前停下！

即便早已接收了原主的记忆！

可真实看到眼前的情况！

“真是真天崩开局啊……”

秦云还是忍不住倒吸了口冷气。

这院子不仅没有门！

连围墙是用碎石块和荆棘条堆起来的。

站在外面，直接就能看见院内的情况。

而所谓的家，则是两间有着巨大裂纹的土坯房！

一大一小！

小的一间是他住的，大的则是原主老娘住的!

除此之外，就是一个用黄泥堆砌而成的灶台！

“求求你，能不吃我吗？！”

不过，怀中的女子刚下地，却直接跪在了秦云面前，“我什么都能干，什么都能做！”

“不要吃我，我不想死！”

说到这里，女子眼泪都流了出来！

“……”

秦云叹了口气！

这个时代，难道只有吃人才是正常的吗？

就在他想将女子拉起来时！

“咳咳！”

一道咳嗽声从大一点的屋子里传来！

随着房门

一个瘦小的老妇人走了出来！

她的眼窝已经陷下去，使得颧骨凸起。

脸上的皮肤贴着骨头上！

看上去已经很久没有吃饱过了。

正是原主的娘亲，秦王氏！

“云儿！你回来了！”

“昨儿个你一夜没回，娘担心死了……！”

见到秦云瞬间，秦王氏枯瘦的脸上，露出了些许激动！

第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Chapter 2 She is my woman!

"What a fool!"

"..."

Facing the discussions of the villagers.

Qin Yun didn't pay any attention, but walked straight to the woman and stretched out his hand!

"Just you!"

Hearing this, the woman's body trembled a few times, and the unwillingness in her eyes turned into despair!

"What are you doing standing there in a daze? Why don't you hurry up and follow us!"

Seeing that Qin Yun had chosen the dish, Fatty Jin Bing said impatiently!

The woman gritted her teeth and struggled to get up!

But I found that my legs were weak and I couldn’t stand up no matter what!

See this scene!

Qin Yun thought for a while, but luckily he picked up the woman and walked to Cunwei's home!

Qingshigou is not big at all, with only thirty households in total.

The end of the village is even more remote, with several dilapidated adobe houses scattered at the foot of the mountain, which look like tombs from a distance.

So it has always been considered bad feng shui!

The families at the end of the village had already moved away!

The only resident is Qin Yun's family.

"We're here!"

Qin Yun stopped in front of a courtyard with the woman in his arms!

Even if he has already received the memory of the original owner!

You can really see the situation in front of you!

"It's such a devastating start..."

Qin Yun couldn't help but take a breath of cold air.

Not only does this yard have no gate!

Even the walls are made of gravel and thorn strips.

Standing outside, you can directly see the situation inside the hospital.

And the so-called home is two adobe houses with huge cracks!

One big and one small!

He lives in the small room, and the original owner’s wife lives in the large room!

In addition, it is a stove made of yellow mud!

"Please, can you stop eating me?!"

However, as soon as the woman in his arms got off the ground, she knelt directly in front of Qin Yun, "I can do anything, I can do anything!"

"Don't eat me, I don't want to die!"

At this point, the woman burst into tears!

"..."

Qin Yun sighed!

In this era, is it normal to only eat people?

Just when he wanted to pull the woman up!

"Ahem!"

A coughing sound came from the larger room!

Following the door

A thin old woman came out!

Her eye sockets had sunken, causing her cheekbones to bulge.

The skin on the face is attached to the bones!

It looked like he hadn't eaten enough in a long time.

It was the original owner’s mother, Prince Qin!

"Yun'er! You're back!"

"You didn't come back all night last night. Mom was worried to death...!"

The moment she saw Qin Yun, Prince Qin's skinny face showed a little excitement!
